clue.text: Just a tap may halt the bird

parts.note: to halt is to stop
a cock is a male bird, the farmyard rooster

explanation.surface: A gentle tap might be enough to stop a bird in its tracks.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopcock is a valve, essentially a tap on a water pipe used to shut off the supply.

clue.text: Remained sober, by the sound of it

indicators.note: the phrase tells us the word for sober is only heard, not spelt

parts.note: staid means sober and sedate

explanation.surface: Someone stayed on the wagon, or so they say.
explanation.definitionFit: To have stayed somewhere is to have remained there, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Duck on the farm going for fruit

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, the letter O
a range is open grazing land on a farm or ranch

explanation.surface: A farmyard duck wanders off in search of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: An orange is a citrus fruit.

clue.text: Shrewd to ignore direction

parts.note: to cut someone is to ignore them deliberately
E, east, is a compass direction

explanation.surface: Being clever enough to pay no attention to instructions.
explanation.definitionFit: Cute in its older sense means clever or sharp-witted, as in a cute move.

clue.text: This provides cover for runners

parts.note: the runners are not athletes but the rings or hooks that slide along a curtain rail, which a decorative strip above a window hides

explanation.surface: Something that shelters athletes on the track.
explanation.definitionFit: A pelmet is a board or fabric strip fixed above a window to conceal the curtain fittings.

clue.text: Cakes supplied by city dens

parts.note: EC is the postcode for the City of London
lairs are animals' dens

explanation.surface: Pastries handed out from city hideaways.
explanation.definitionFit: Eclairs are long choux pastries filled with cream, a kind of small cake.

clue.text: Drawing ten' magic circles

indicators.note: the letters circle about, moving round into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A magician's ten rings, perhaps, catching the eye.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray apostrophe after 'ten' is a print blemish. 'Drawing' is not a picture here but pulling towards, as a magnet does.
explanation.definitionFit: Something magnetic attracts or pulls things towards it, so it is drawing them in.

clue.text: Get a lute out and have some lessons

indicators.note: out signals these letters are thrown out of their arrangement and remade

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A music student fetches a lute and takes a few lessons.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutelage is instruction or tuition, a course of teaching.

clue.text: Corrupt laity accept a credit with eager willingness

indicators.note: to accept is to take in, so one group of letters goes inside the other
corrupt means spoiled or twisted, so the word is rearranged

explanation.surface: Lay churchgoers gone bad take money eagerly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Corrupt' looks like it describes the churchgoers, but it is the anagram signal; 'accept' means the shuffled word takes the other letters inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Alacrity means brisk eagerness or readiness to act.

clue.text: So thin as to warrant an insult?

explanation.surface: Is calling someone skinny a put-down?
explanation.definitionFit: Slight means slender as an adjective and a snub as a noun.

clue.text: Small fish mobbing seabird by plant collection :

indicators.note: mobbing means crowding round, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: fry are young, small fish
the erne is the sea eagle, a crossword stalwart

explanation.surface: Little fish crowd around a sea eagle beside a garden display.
explanation.definitionFit: A fernery is a place where ferns are grown, a collection of those plants.

clue.text: A drink is needed, for example? Gong to be beaten

indicators.note: beaten means knocked about, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone needs a drink, so the dinner gong is struck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be beaten' turns GONG into GNOG.
explanation.definitionFit: Eggnog is a drink of eggs, milk, sugar and usually spirits.

clue.text: Medical description of one region — there's a series of changes rung around Ireland

indicators.note: around tells us one piece wraps about the other

parts.note: a peal is a set of changes rung on church bells
Erin is a poetic name for Ireland

explanation.surface: Bell-ringers ring round Ireland while a doctor describes an area of the body.
explanation.definitionFit: Perineal is the medical adjective for the perineum, a region of the body.

clue.text: I'm a drab sort of local, employee.

indicators.note: a sort of something is a variant of it, so the letters are put into another order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A pub worker confesses to being rather dull.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'local' is British slang for one's nearby pub, so a local employee works behind its bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A pub worker who serves drinks at a bar, the pub being a local.

clue.text: Removing all traces?

parts.note: the traces are not clues or evidence but the straps by which a horse pulls a cart, all taken off

explanation.surface: Wiping out every sign of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Unharnessing a horse means taking off its harness, including the traces that link it to the vehicle.

clue.text: ICI smart to deploy this weapon.

indicators.note: to deploy is to spread out and arrange, so the letters are set out anew

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A big chemical firm smartly brings a sword into action.
explanation.walkthrough: ICI was Imperial Chemical Industries, a large British firm.
explanation.definitionFit: A scimitar is a curved oriental sword, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Fields may be while awaiting guidance

parts.note: until means up to the time of, as while awaiting something
led means guided, the guidance having been given

explanation.surface: Something left as it is until someone gives directions.
explanation.definitionFit: Fields that have not been ploughed are described as not cultivated.

clue.text: Clean room and get prepared for the mass

indicators.note: prepared means made ready, worked into shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Tidy up and get ready before the church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mass' looks like the church service the surface suggests, but it means a large aggregate or cluster.
explanation.definitionFit: A conglomerate is a mass of different things clustered together.

clue.text: Perhaps valiant national

indicators.note: perhaps hints at a possible variation, so the letters may be reordered

explanation.surface: A brave citizen of some country.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latvian is a national, or citizen, of Latvia.

clue.text: Path enabling us to find immortal — look inside!

indicators.note: look inside tells the solver to search within the run of words

explanation.surface: A route that leads us to a goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: Athena is a Greek goddess, and the gods were immortal.

clue.text: The firm set out to pamper us

annotationWithheld.clue: The firm set out to pamper us

clue.text: Still say you have to keep things going?

definitions.meaning: keep something in good order or in operation

explanation.surface: Do you still insist on keeping the show on the road?
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain is both to assert something and to keep it going.

clue.text: King George leading boy to the cave

parts.note: GR is Georgius Rex, King George
Otto is a boy's name

explanation.surface: The king leads a young lad towards a cavern.
explanation.definitionFit: A grotto is a small, often picturesque cave.

clue.text: Priest giving note to mother

parts.note: la is a note of the sol-fa scale
ma is a familiar word for mother

explanation.surface: A cleric passing a message to his mum.
explanation.definitionFit: A lama is a Tibetan Buddhist priest or monk.

clue.text: Capital all sunk in metal

indicators.note: sunk in means placed inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: tin is a metal

explanation.surface: A whole city's wealth tied up in metal.
explanation.walkthrough: TALLIN is an older spelling of Tallinn, capital of Estonia.
explanation.definitionFit: Tallinn, spelt here with one N as in older atlases, is the capital city of Estonia.

clue.text: Chap quite at home, we hear, with creatures in the main

parts.note: a chap is a man

indicators.note: we hear signals the words are judged only by sound

parts.note: comfortable and relaxed, at ease

explanation.surface: A man perfectly relaxed among sea creatures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The main' is a poetic name for the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Manatees are large aquatic mammals, sea cows, living in coastal waters.

clue.text: Laughing, remove tip of spear

indicators.note: remove tip of means take off the first letter of the word

parts.note: a trident is a three-pronged spear

explanation.surface: Someone laughing as they take the point off a spear.
explanation.definitionFit: Rident is a literary word for laughing or smiling broadly.

clue.text: Military leader with questionable, stamina, on the boat

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of the word
questionable means doubtful, so the letters are not to be trusted in their order

explanation.surface: An army chief of doubtful endurance aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: The commas in the clue are print blemishes. 'questionable' turns STAMINA into AINMAST.
explanation.definitionFit: A mainmast is the principal mast found on a sailing ship.
